description: This file contains unit tests for the VertxBasedHttpProtocolAdapter class within the Eclipse Hono project. The tests verify HTTP request handling, authentication, downstream message sending, and command response functionalities of the adapter, including edge cases and error scenarios.

classes.name: VertxBasedHttpProtocolAdapterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying behavior of VertxBasedHttpProtocolAdapter in various scenarios including authentication, telemetry, event handling, and command responses within the Eclipse Hono framework.

methods.name: deployAdapter
methods.description: Initializes and deploys the HTTP adapter with mocked dependencies before all tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares test fixture by setting up mocks for each test case.

methods.name: finishTest
methods.description: Undeploys the adapter and closes Vertx instance after all tests.

methods.name: testPostTelemetryFailsForMissingBasicAuthHeader
methods.description: Verifies POST telemetry fails with 401 when no Authorization header is present.

methods.name: testPostTelemetryFailsForInvalidCredentials
methods.description: Verifies POST telemetry fails with 401 when invalid credentials are supplied.

methods.name: testPostTelemetryFailsForUnreachableCredentialsService
methods.description: Verifies POST telemetry fails with 503 when credentials service cannot be reached.

methods.name: testPostTelemetrySucceedsForValidCredentials
methods.description: Verifies POST telemetry succeeds with valid credentials, expecting 202.

methods.name: testPutTelemetrySucceedsForValidCredentials
methods.description: Verifies PUT telemetry succeeds with valid credentials, expecting 202.

methods.name: testPostTelemetryFailsForNotSupportedQoSLevel
methods.description: Verifies that QoS level 2 results in a 400 Bad Request.

methods.name: testPostTelemetrySucceedsForQoS1
methods.description: Verifies that QoS level 1 results in a successful 202 response and downstream message send.

methods.name: testPutEventSucceedsForValidCredentials
methods.description: Verifies PUT event request with valid credentials returns 202.

methods.name: testPostTelemetryWithTtdSucceedsWithCommandInResponse
methods.description: Tests that when TTD parameter is specified, a command is included in response if pending.

methods.name: testPostCmdResponseForInvalidCommandRequestIdResultsIn400
methods.description: Checks that malformed command request ID results in 400 Bad Request.

methods.name: testPostCmdResponseForInvalidCommandStatusIdResultsIn400
methods.description: Checks invalid command status results in 400.

methods.name: testPostCmdResponseForMissingCommandStatusIdResultsIn400
methods.description: Checks missing command status parameter results in 400.

methods.name: testPostCmdResponseForNotExistingCommandResponseLinkResultsIn503
methods.description: Simulates failure in sending command response, expecting 503.

methods.name: testPostCmdResponseForExistingCommandResponseLinkResultsInAccepted
methods.description: Valid command response results in 202 when delivery is remotely settled.
